text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in your direct message. Moss's notes name two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, in Moss's Sunday prep note from 5 Oct 2025. Thea Ramaswell logged it about drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) not getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it the same evening and Thea confirmed the fix the next morning.
- **#4419**, in Moss's undated North cheat sheet. Thea logged it about gatehouse barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

Moss's other two North notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers, and the Central notes don't cover it at all.

I also flagged one conflict. A note by Marcus Lindqvist, not Moss, gives #4419 as a Gate 3 printer delay, not a scanner problem. Nothing in the files says which description is right, so Dana should check before it goes in the weekly notes.

I only used notes Dana can open herself: all of Moss's notes are public team files. I left out IT ticket #4092 because it's about a meeting-room hub, not this customer, and the Quarendon Freightways competitor note because that company isn't the same customer.
